raw.description:
Preiswecker is a price comparison portal in Germany, helping thousands of users find the best deals online every day.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help build our price comparison platform.

We are currently offering the following position:

Software Engineer - Price comparison portal

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain features for our price comparison platform
  • Develop and optimize data pipelines that process merchant price feeds
  • Work closely with Product and BI to ship reliable, scalable features
  • Write clean, well-tested code and participate in code reviews
  • Monitor and improve performance of our systems

Qualifications

  • completed degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • solid experience with backend development and relational databases
  • familiarity with modern software engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, version control)
  • analytical mindset and a strong sense of ownership
  • good German and English

Benefits

  • flexible working hours and remote work options
  • flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths
  • modern office in a central location
  • training budget
  • fair salary and growth opportunities

We look forward to your application!

Build-vs-Buy & Tool Evaluation: Du bewertest neue Tools und Frameworks entlang von Kosten, Nutzen und Skalierbarkeit und gibst eine begründete Empfehlung: selbst bauen oder einkaufen. Technologie ist dabei Mittel, nicht Ergebnis. Deine Arbeit soll uns mehr Anfragen bringen, die Abschlussquote erhöhen, Entscheidungswege verkürzen oder Wachstum ohne zusätzliche Verwaltung ermöglichen – messbar in Stunden, Kosten pro Vorgang und Durchlaufzeit. Studium: BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business o. Ä. – als Praktikum im Studium oder danach. Kein Informatikstudium nötig – zeig uns einfach etwas, das du gebaut hast: ein Automatisierungs-Flow, ein GPT, ein Dashboard, ein Nebenprojekt. Was wir Dir bieten Sinnvolle Arbeit mit direktem Impact: Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Business Cases, sondern an Systemen, die echte Bildungschancen schneller erreichbar machen – mit direkter Wirkung auf Arbeitsmarktintegration und Fachkräftesicherung. Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst tiefe Einblicke in den Aufbau einer skalierenden Organisation – von CRM-Architektur über datengetriebene Steuerung bis zu moderner Growth- und KI-Infrastruktur. Ein Profil, das danach gesucht wird: Du kannst ein Geschäftsmodell durch seine Daten lesen, Prozesskosten rechnen und ein System bauen und einführen. Diese Kombination öffnet Türen – im Venture Building, in der Beratung und in jeder operativen Führungsrolle. Hybrid & Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Berliner Büro, mit klaren Strukturen, moderner digitaler Infrastruktur und einem Team, das auf Vertrauen, Ownership und Ergebnisse setzt. Faire Vergütung & Perspektive: Leistungsbezogene Vergütung und bei überzeugender Leistung das Gespräch über eine Weiterbeschäftigung. Teamspirit & Sparring: Fachliche Begleitung durch Kolleg:innen aus Infrastruktur, Data, Sales und Marketing, regelmäßiges Feedback und Zugang zu unseren eigenen Weiterbildungsangeboten.   • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 200+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.
  • Coordinate display assembly, capacity planning, timelines, and escalations.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: After reviewing your CV, Eric, our Talent Acquisition Manager, will have a 30-minute screening interview with you to discuss more about HOLY and the position and see if our expectations match.

Qualifikation Du besitzt zwei Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Support, Customer Success oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit entsprechend technischem Ausbildungshintergrund. Du zeichnest dich durch dein technisches Wissen, eine stets kunden- und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und deine Verbindlichkeit aus. Dabei bist du gut organisiert, eigenständig und verfügst über ein exzellentes Zeitmanagement. Du hast Erfahrungen mit CRM-Anwendungen und Ticketing-Systemen und bist offen für neue Technologien und KI-gestützte Tools. Deine sehr guten Deutschkenntnisse (C-Level) sowie deine ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich) ermöglichen dir einen stets empathischen Umgang mit unseren Kunden und natürlich auch deinen Kollegen. Benefits Bei uns erwarten Dich flexible Arbeitszeiten unter Berücksichtigung unserer Supportzeiten von Mo-Fr von 9-17 Uhr. Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, auch Homeoffice ist bei uns möglich. Wir statten Dich mit modernen Arbeitsgeräten und einem zeitgemäßen Arbeitsplatz aus. Du entscheidest selbst, ob Du mit Mac oder Windows arbeitest. Als Unternehmen leben wir eine moderne Kollaboration. Intuitive und zeitsparende Tools sind fest in unseren Alltag integriert. Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer in einem motivierten Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du in diesem selbstständig. Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge. description: Wer Du bist Du hast 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Java-Stack und beherrschst Spring Boot souverän. Du entwickelst komplexe Features eigenständig von der Konzeption bis zum Release, denkst analytisch und trägst aktiv zu Architekturentscheidungen bei. Du nutzt KI-Assistenz (z.B. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) als etabliertes Produktivitätswerkzeug – nicht nur zum Code-Generieren, sondern auch für komplexe Refactorings, Architektur-Diskussionen und Debugging – übernimmst aber die volle Verantwortung für Qualität, Security und Nachvollziehbarkeit der Lösungen. Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe mit Stakeholdern und unterstützt gern weniger erfahrene Entwickler beim Wachsen. Wer wir sind Plunet GmbH mit Standorten in Berlin, Würzburg und New York entwickelt und vertreibt die Business- und Workflow-Management-Software „Plunet BusinessManager“ – eine der weltweit führenden Managementlösungen für die Übersetzungs- und Lokalisierungsbranche. Unsere Kunden sind führende Übersetzungsagenturen, Regierungsorganisationen und NGOs sowie große internationale Industrie- und Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Aufgaben Entwicklung & Architektur: Du entwirfst und implementierst komplexe, skalierbare Backend-Lösungen mit Spring Boot, inkl. Konfiguration von Security-Mechanismen und Integration von Drittbibliotheken. Du hilfst mit, technische Lösungen in unserer Software-Architektur zu gestalten. Qualitätssicherung: Du führst Code Reviews durch und stellst umfassende Testabdeckung mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest sicher – inkl. komplexer Integrationstests Legacy & Modernisierung: Du refactorst bestehenden Code und modernisierst Kernkomponenten (Main Classes), ohne dabei die Systemstabilität zu gefährden. Datenbanken: Du optimierst Datenbankabfragen und -designs (MySQL/MSSQL) und setzt Hibernate als ORM-Werkzeug für komplexe Mapping-Szenarien fortgeschritten ein. Wissenstransfer: Du bist aktives Mitglied in unseren Communities of Practice (CoPs), leitest diese bei Bedarf und mentorst Junior-Entwickler bei Onboarding und fachlicher Entwicklung. Integration: Du integrierst den Plunet BusinessManager mit externen Systemen und arbeitest eng mit Product Specialists zusammen. KI-Integration: Du nutzt KI-Tools effektiv für Entwicklungstasks, validierst generierten Code kritisch hinsichtlich Clean Code, Security und Performance und hilfst mit, Best Practices für den KI-Einsatz im Team zu etablieren. Qualifikation Erfahrung: 3-5 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit Schwerpunkt Backend/Java. Java Advanced: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse von Design Patterns, Multithreading, Concurrency und aktuellen Java-Versionen. Spring Boot: Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer, skalierbarer Anwendungen; sicherer Umgang mit Security-Konfiguration und externer API-Integration. Softwaretests: Advanced-Level in Unit- und Integrationstests mit JUnit, Mockito und SpringBootTest; Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung. Datenbanken: Fortgeschrittene SQL-Kenntnisse (MySQL, MSSQL), Query-Optimierung und sicherer Umgang mit Hibernate. Tooling: Sicherer Umgang mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines und modernen IDEs (IntelliJ, VSCode). KI-Assistenz Professional: Erfahrener Umgang mit KI-Coding-Assistenz für komplexe Entwicklungsszenarien; Fähigkeit zum effektiven Prompt Engineering; kritische Bewertung von KI-Vorschlägen hinsichtlich Architektur-Patterns, Security-Risiken und Datenschutz; Bewusstsein für Limitationen und Halluzinationen. Clean Code: Du lebst Clean Code-Prinzipien aktiv und hilfst anderen dabei, besser zu werden. Soft Skills: Starke analytische Fähigkeit zur Analyse komplexer Anforderungen und Entwurf effizienter Lösungen; hervorragende Selbstorganisation (Priorisierung, Zeitmanagement); exzellente Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit Architekten und Stakeholdern; Bereitschaft, Junior-Entwickler zu mentoren und Wissen weiterzugeben. Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2+), Deutsch ist ein Plus. Nice-to-haves (Zusätzliche Aktivitäten & Skills) Security: Erfahrung mit der Analyse und Behebung von Sicherheitslücken in Dependencies (OWASP Dependency-Check, Sicherheitsmanagement). DevOps/Tooling: Kenntnisse in Liquibase, SonarQube, GitLab Administration oder Docker. Performance: Erfahrung mit Performance-Analyse (Thread-Dumps, Heap-Dumps) und Last-tests. Fullstack-Perspektive: Grundkenntnisse in Angular, TypeScript oder .NET. Methodik: Erfahrung mit agilen Frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) als aktiver Teamplayer. Schulung: Du erstellst Präsentationen und Schulungen für andere Entwickler, um spezifisches Wissen zu verbreiten. Benefits Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Work-Life-Balance Flexible Arbeitszeiten und faire Überstundenregelungen sorgen für eine gesunde Balance zwischen Berufs- und Privatleben. Eigenverantwortung & agile Unternehmenskultur Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in einem transparenten und agilen Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien. Teamgeist & Zusammenarbeit Eine offene, respektvolle Unternehmenskultur, in der Teamarbeit großgeschrieben wird. Exklusive Benefits & Zusatzleistungen Du profitierst von Hrmony (digitalen Essenszuschüssen), einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und unserer Kooperation mit JobRad für eine komfortable Mobilität. title: (Junior) Human Resources Manager (m/w/d)
description: Codewerk steht für Technikbegeisterung, Innovation und Zuverlässigkeit mit flachen Hierarchien, Freiraum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Ob in Zügen oder Industrieanlagen – wir bringen die Systeme von morgen dazu, miteinander zu reden. Für den weiteren Unternehmensaufbau brauchen wir Deine Hilfe im Bereich Human Resources. Deine Rolle wird es sein, den HR Bereich mit zu gestalten und auszubauen. Mit viel Freiraum übernimmst Du Deine Aufgabengebiete und verantwortest unterschiedlichste Themen. Starte mit uns durch in Karlsruhe oder Berlin ! Aufgaben Wie Du es von einem kleinen Unternehmen erwartest: Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst sämtliche Personalprozesse, die Du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Unternehmensleitung vorantreibst. Employer Branding und Recruiting gehören ebenso zu Deinen Aufgaben wie die Organisation und Begleitung von Feedback‑ und Zielgesprächen. Du erkennst, welche HR-Strukturen und Angebote wir als Unternehmen noch aufbauen oder weiterentwickeln müssen, und bringst diese Themen eigenständig in die Umsetzung – intern oder mit externen Partnern. Auch bei den administrativen HR-Themen den Überblick und Du kümmerst Dich darum, dass Verträge, Personalakten und unsere HR-Systeme aktuell sind. Du gestaltest unsere Unternehmenskultur und Zusammenarbeit aktiv mit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns die Rahmenbedingungen für weiteres Wachstum in dem Du u.a. unser Personalvergütungsprogramm mit gestaltest. Insgesamt erhältst Du einen tiefen Einblick in alle Unternehmensprozesse und hast die Chance, die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Qualifikation Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich BWL, Recht oder Psychologie oder vergleichbarem Studium. Alternativ über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Bereich Human Resources. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem relevanten Aufgabengebiete. Du verbindest fachliches und methodisches Know-how und bringst es dort ein, wo es dem Unternehmen am meisten nützt. Dabei fällt es Dir leicht, Strukturen und Zusammenhänge zu erkennen und diese aufzubereiten. Du arbeitest sicher mit Recruiting-Tools und kennst die Besonderheiten des deutschsprachigen Arbeitsmarktes sowie des deutschen Arbeits- und Betriebsverfassungsrechts. Ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Leidenschaft für HR-Themen zeichnen dich aus. Dabei stellst Du dich flexibel auf unterschiedliche Situationen und Gesprächspartner ein. Als kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit bringst Du eine hohe Beratungskompetenz mit und überzeugst durch Deine Empathie im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften. Dabei greifst Du auf sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse zurück. Unternehmerisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen sowie ein hohes Maß an Selbständigkeit und Durchsetzungsvermögen zeichnen Dich aus. Du hast Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem nicht alles bereits festgelegt ist. Benefits Interessante, anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und die Möglichkeit, Codewerk auf dem Weg vom kleinen zum mittelständischen Unternehmen zu begleiten. Ein offenes und kommunikatives Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Freiraum und Kollegen, die Dich mitnehmen: fachlich wie auch zum Feierabendgetränk. Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz. Erstattung des Deutschlandtickets und eine sehr gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr. Eine flexible Homeoffice-Regelung Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, mit Deinem Beitrag die Zukunft des Unternehmens nachhaltig mitzugestalten. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you will play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value.

  • Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.
  • Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.
  • Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

  • Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

General:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a related field
  • At least one prior internship, working student role, or comparable work placement (in energy, consulting, product, or a fast-moving startup environment preferred)
  • Strong ownership mindset - comfortable driving your own initiatives with minimal handholding (with support always available from your direct lead)
  • Analytical and structured thinker, comfortable with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets a must, SQL or Python a plus)

  • Available for at least 6 months, ideally full-time
  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Du hast Erfahrung darin, mehrere Projekte und unterschiedliche Stakeholder parallel zu koordinieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und auch bei zunehmender Komplexität den Überblick zu behalten. Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Verlässlichkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein und bist bereit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung zu übernehmen. Lebenslanges Lernen durch Weiterbildung, Wissenstransfer, Mentoring und persönliche Entwicklung. Ein modernes Büro direkt am Karlsruher Hauptbahnhof mit sehr guter Anbindung. title: Technical Recruiter (gn) Schwerpunkt Softwareentwicklung
description: Technical Recruiter (gn), remote, vollzeit, ab sofort. Du erkennst, ob hinter einem technischen Profil die Erfahrung steckt, die ein Projekt wirklich braucht? Und du hast Freude daran, passende Menschen zu finden und für eine Zusammenarbeit zu gewinnen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir suchen eine_n_ Technical Recruiter (gn) _, der/_die uns bei der Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen unterstützt. Aktuell liegt der Schwerpunkt auf Softwareentwicklung. Perspektivisch suchen wir auch für Rollen im Produkt- und Projektumfeld, etwa Product Owner, Projektmanager:_innen und Business Analyst:_innen. New Monday ist eine UX/UI-Agentur aus Berlin. Wir arbeiten an digitalen Produkten für Unternehmen wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP und Lufthansa sowie für junge Unternehmen wie NUMA Stays. Unser Team arbeitet zu 100% remote. Dabei setzen wir auf eigenständiges Arbeiten, kurze Wege und einen engen Austausch miteinander – digital und immer öfter auch bei persönlichen Treffen. Aufgaben Du begleitest die Besetzung unserer technischen Positionen – aktuell vor allem in der Softwareentwicklung, perspektivisch auch in Rollen wie Product Ownership, Projektmanagement und Business Analyse. Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, ordnest Profile fachlich ein und beurteilst, wie gut Erfahrung und Projekthintergrund zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Bei Bedarf findest du passende Kandidat*innen über LinkedIn und weitere Recruiting-Kanäle und sprichst sie persönlich an. Du führst erste Gespräche und klärst technische Erfahrung, Motivation sowie Rahmendaten wie Verfügbarkeit und Gehaltsvorstellung. Du stimmst dich eng mit unseren fachlichen Ansprechpartner:innen ab, bereitest Interviews vor und begleitest Kandidat:innen verbindlich durch den gesamten Prozess. Du pflegst unsere Bewerbungsprozesse im Bewerbersystem und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen an den Schnittstellen zwischen Recruiting, Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung zuverlässig fließen. Du beobachtest den Markt und gibst uns Rückmeldung, wie wir unsere Suche und Ansprache verbessern können. Qualifikation Du hast Erfahrung im Recruiting und Active Sourcing technischer Fachkräfte und hast insbesondere Positionen in der Softwareentwicklung bereits erfolgreich besetzt. Du verstehst die Unterschiede zwischen Frontend-, Backend- und Fullstack-Profilen und kannst praktische Projekterfahrung gezielt hinterfragen. Idealerweise kennst du auch Profile aus dem Produkt- und Projektumfeld. Begriffe wie Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, REST-APIs, CI/CD und Kubernetes sind dir vertraut. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln können, kannst technische Lebensläufe aber sicher einordnen und mit Kandidat*innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen. Du arbeitest routiniert mit Bewerbermanagementsystemen und digitalen Recruiting-Tools. Erfahrung mit JOIN ist ein Plus. Du kommunizierst wertschätzend und sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl schriftlich als auch im Gespräch. Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und transparent und behältst mehrere Suchprozesse gleichzeitig im Blick. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Ansprache und die Organisation deiner Arbeit einzusetzen und prüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig. Benefits Das erwartet dich bei New Monday 100 % remote: Du arbeitest innerhalb Deutschlands von dem Ort aus, der für dich passt. Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenständig, mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und ohne Micromanagement. Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte Team zusammen. Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung. Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir dabei regelmäßig mit dir. 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events. Arbeit mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung ein und hilfst uns, unser Recruiting für technische Rollen weiterzuentwickeln. So geht es weiter Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday und die Rolle. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind. Gespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti: Wir lernen uns ausführlicher kennen und sprechen darüber, wie du technische Recruiting-Prozesse gestaltest und mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammenarbeiten würdest. Fachliches Follow-up: Anhand konkreter Recruiting-Situationen sprechen wir darüber, wie du Bewerbungen einschätzt, passende Kandidat*innen findest und Entscheidungen vorbereitest. Du bekommst außerdem Gelegenheit, mit einer Person aus dem Team unter vier Augen zu sprechen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst. New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Digital Marketing Executive
raw.description:
Role Overview

We’re hiring a Digital Marketing Executive to develop and manage marketing campaigns that drive demand and inbound leads, while executing localised lead acquisition strategies to grow our pipeline.

Working closely with the Sales team, you’ll use channels including email, SEO/SEM, social media, and paid media to drive customer acquisition and build a robust pipeline of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs).

You’ll also manage account-based marketing initiatives using a CRM platform such as HubSpot, with a focus on delivering measurable results and supporting our growth across markets.

Strategic Context

Transreport exists to remove structural barriers in rail travel. Our vision is that everyone has access to travel everywhere.

We operate across the UK, Japan, and the EU and have supported over 10 million assistance requests for more than 1.8 million users. We are a Series A company recognised with a King’s Award.

As we continue to grow across our existing markets and expand into new ones, this role will help drive demand and build a strong pipeline of qualified leads through effective, localised digital marketing and account-based marketing initiatives.

Tasks

About the Role:

  • Develop and implement online demand generation strategies, tactics, and processes to drive inbound leads and generate MQLs.
  • Create, manage, and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns, including email, SEO/SEM, social media, and paid media, to drive customer acquisition.
  • Develop and implement strategic account-based marketing plans to target key accounts, aligned with the overall marketing and sales strategies.
  • Track, measure, monitor, and report on the success of marketing activities, providing regular reports with a focus on conversion rate, CPA and LTV
  • Contribute to the content marketing plan through the website, email, social media channels, and partners, addressing key challenges for customers and creating compelling customer content.
  • Support the implementation of new systems and processes to increase the client footprint and improve marketing performance.
  • Work within an agreed budget and ensure the best Return on Investment (ROI) for marketing campaigns.

Requirements

About You

We expect you to:

  • 3+ years’ experience in a B2B digital marketing role, with a focus on demand generation and customer acquisition.
  • Advanced SEO and PPC skills, with experience in leveraging SEO, PPC, Google AdWords, Facebook, LinkedIn and Twitter to achieve commercial goals.
  • Proven experience in managing account-based marketing campaigns using a CRM platform
  • Familiarity with content marketing strategies and creating compelling customer content.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in using Google Analytics 4 and other relevant tools to support marketing efforts.
  • Experience with CMS platforms such as WordPress.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Forward-thinking, strategic mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture while paying attention to details.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRO testing methodologies to continuously improve on-site experience
  • Experience of using design software such as Adobe Creative Suite or Canva
  • Personal/lived experience of disability/access barriers
  • Professional experience in the transport sector

Benefits

  • Private healthcare after your probation (including children)
  • Hybrid working model
  • 25 days holiday
  • Volunteering Leave
  • Free flu jab for you and your family

Culture & Operating Principles

We value:

  • Ownership over hierarchy
  • Clarity over bureaucracy
  • Impact over job titles

We operate with high autonomy and high accountability. People are expected to raise risks early, communicate clearly, and take responsibility for outcomes.

Guaranteed Interview Scheme

We’re a Disability Confident employer and we welcome applications from disabled candidates. If you need any adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please tell us what would help - we’ll work with you to make the process as accessible as possible.

We also offer a Guaranteed Interview Scheme (GIS) for candidates who consider themselves to have a disability as defined under the Equality Act 2010.

If you indicate this option in your application and your application demonstrates that you meet the essential criteria for the role, you’ll be invited to interview or assessment.

Choosing GIS doesn’t guarantee a job offer. If you have any questions, please get in touch.

raw.title: Chief Financial Officer (all genders)
raw.description:
Your mission

deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.

Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.

description: Location: Fully remote in Europe Working Hours: Mon - Fri, 9AM - 6PM About Nivoda 🚀 Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise. Our Mission 🎯 Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry. About the Role 🤔 As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution. It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one. What will you be doing? 😎 Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India) Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance What do we need from you? 💪 Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically Extensive US import-export experience is required. Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact Nice to have ✨ Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India) Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics Experience with Indian export processes Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business Our culture and what we offer 😉 At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability. Our current benefits 🕰️ Flexible working and a vibrant company culture 💻 Remote work 🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning 🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance 🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase Equal Opportunity Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable. Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly. Not quite the right fit? If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our Nivoda Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up. Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. We’re the strategic payments partner for some of the best known fast-moving brands globally such as Wise, Hut Group, Sony Electronics, Homebase, Henkel, Klarna and many others. Purpose-built with performance and scalability in mind, our flexible cloud-based payments platform helps global enterprises launch new products and create experiences customers love. And it's not just what we build that makes us different. It's how.

We empower passionate problem-solvers to collaborate, innovate and do their best work. That’s why we’re on the Forbes Cloud 100 list and a Great Place to Work accredited company. And we’re just getting started. We’re building diverse and inclusive teams around the world — because that’s how we create even better experiences for our merchants and our partners.

Role overview | Context

In this role, you will play a key part in delivering, optimising, and continuously evolving the London office experience across our UK operations.

You will own critical operational areas, driving performance through data and ensuring the workplace operates with precision, accountability, and consistency. Acting as a link between strategy and execution, you will translate workplace priorities into scalable processes, measurable outcomes, and high quality day to day experiences.

You will take ownership across workplace operations, vendor management, reporting, and governance, with the autonomy to make decisions and lead on key initiatives.

This is a high impact role suited to someone who thrives in fast paced environments, brings a strong analytical mindset, and is motivated by raising the bar for workplace experience and operational excellence.

You will take a customer first approach to every interaction, proactively understanding employee and visitor needs, resolving issues through to completion, and using insight and data to continuously improve the workplace experience.


Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities

Amongst other duties, this role will be primarily responsible for the below.

Operational Leadership & Delivery

  • Own day to day workplace operations, ensuring the office runs smoothly, safely, and consistently while delivering a seamless employee and visitor experience.

  • Act as a visible and trusted on site point of contact, ensuring workplace spaces, services, and touchpoints are well maintained, well stocked, and delivered to a high standard.

  • Conduct regular workplace walkthroughs to identify, resolve, and escalate issues before they affect employees or visitors, maintaining consistently high standards across presentation, safety, functionality, and hospitality.

  • Drive operational excellence through strong execution, accountability, and continuous improvement across all Workplace activities.

  • Lead and support workplace initiatives, aligning delivery with Workplace strategy, business needs, and opportunities to enhance the day to day employee experience and operational efficiency.

Financial Management

  • Own the UK Workplace budget end to end, including tracking, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost optimisation

  • Lead procurement, PO management, and invoicing processes with accuracy and efficiency

  • Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to resolve issues and improve processes

  • Manage vendor commercials, including pricing negotiations and contract renewals

Vendor & Contract Management

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key vendors and site partners, including building management, cleaning and maintenance providers, acting as the primary point of contact for day-to-day operational matters.

  • Proactively manage supplier communication, ensuring expectations are clear, issues are resolved promptly, and services are delivered consistently to agreed standards.

  • Drive day to day vendor performance by monitoring service levels, holding suppliers accountable, providing regular feedback, and escalating risks or recurring issues where appropriate.

  • Support contract management by maintaining accurate supplier records, tracking key dates and renewals, and coordinating contract administration.

  • Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, service delivery, and operational efficiency through regular reviews, performance reporting, and ongoing collaboration.

Data, Reporting & Performance

  • Own Workplace reporting frameworks, dashboards, and KPI tracking

  • Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting across budget, operations, and workplace experience metrics

  • Combine operational data, service usage, employee feedback, and qualitative insight to identify trends, prioritise improvements, and measure the impact of changes on the employee experience.

  • Track service performance measures including employee satisfaction, response and resolution times, service usage, recurring issues, and supplier performance; communicate outcomes and actions clearly to stakeholders.

  • Ensure team accountability to reporting standards and performance metrics

  • Supporting engagement with building management (e.g. CBRE), ensuring issue tracking, resolution, and accountability

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across People, Finance, and wider business teams including senior leadership

Compliance & Sustainability

  • Own Workplace compliance and reporting obligations (e.g. SECR, ESOS, energy reporting)

  • Ensure alignment with regulatory, environmental, and company standards

  • Drive improvements in sustainability performance

Workplace Experience & Projects

  • Oversee experience led services (e.g. Food & Beverage), ensuring quality, consistency, and cost control

  • Partner with Workplace Coordinator(s) to deliver an exceptional day to day employee experience

  • Lead Workplace projects end to end and implement scalable process improvements

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance workplace experience and operational efficiency

  • Build a sense of community through thoughtful workplace activations, local events, welcome moments, and connection opportunities that respond to employee needs and reinforce Checkout’s culture.

  • Gather employee feedback through regular informal engagement, surveys, and service touchpoints, ensuring concerns are acknowledged, resolved, and closed out with clear communication.

  • A customer first, hospitality minded approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships and create positive, personalised employee and visitor experiences.

  • Strong financial acumen, with experience in budget management, forecasting, and cost control

  • Confidence coordinating suppliers across hard and soft facilities management, responding to building issues, and escalating technical or compliance matters appropriately.

  • Experience managing vendors and contracts, with a strong understanding of SLAs and performance management

  • Highly data driven mindset, with the ability to translate insights into action

  • Exceptional organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, confident working across all levels

  • Ability to operate autonomously, take ownership, and make decisions with confidence

  • A proactive, solutions focused approach with a drive for continuous improvement

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Highly self-sufficient and proactive, with sound judgement, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to identify priorities and deliver solutions with minimal direction.

raw.title: Chief Financial Officer - Satispay Bank (Relocation to Luxembourg)
raw.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

 

What you'll be doing

As CFO for our Luxembourg-regulated entity, you will be primarily responsible for maintaining the financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and fiscal oversight of Satispay's European hub. Acting as a regulator-approved key executive, your role involves aligning ambitious group-wide corporate goals with the demands of banking compliance, managing the local balance sheet, and safeguarding the entity's capital adequacy.
You will lead the entity's scalable Finance function, including statutory reporting, financial control, audit coordination, finance operations, and integration with the Group Finance organisation to support Satispay's growth and regulatory evolution.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Reporting & Compliance: Take full accountability for the preparation and delivery of local statutory accounts, regulatory filings, and financial information required for Group consolidation, ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and timeliness. Ensure adherence to Lux GAAP/IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, and Group reporting policies.

  • Financial Strategy & Liquidity: Oversee the management of liquidity risks and the protection of client funds as per e-money statutes, while implementing effective yield-enhancement tactics for surplus liquidity. Lead treasury activities across the Luxembourg entity, including cash management, cash forecasting, and coordination with the Treasury team.

  • Risk Management: Track and uphold institutional capital benchmarks, establishing proactive detection mechanisms for market and liquidity exposures. Partner closely with the Chief Risk Officer and other control functions to ensure effective oversight of financial risks, including liquidity, capital, and balance sheet-related risks.

  • Stakeholder Representation: Act as Satispay's primary financial representative to regulatory bodies, tax offices, and external auditors, ensuring the successful execution of annual audits.

  • Financial Control & Performance Reporting: Oversee the Financial Control and Controlling functions, ensuring accurate month-end reporting, balance sheet integrity, and timely management information for local and Group stakeholders. Provide financial analysis and insights to support strategic decision-making and business performance monitoring.

  • Finance Operations: Ensure efficient and scalable Finance Operations processes, including reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close activities. Establish and maintain a strong financial control environment across all operational finance processes.

  • Intercompany Integration: Work closely with the Group CFO and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration of local financial activities, reporting, treasury, and planning processes within the Group Finance framework.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

 

What we're looking for

We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.

  • Executive Experience: At least 8 years of leadership in financial roles at a primary EU financial hub or within Luxembourg-regulated payment institutions, EMIs, or banks.

  • Compliance & Regulatory Mastery: Deep knowledge of CRR/CRD directives, CSSF requirements, Luxembourgish accounting (Lux GAAP/IFRS), and safeguarding standards.

  • Regulatory Eligibility: Candidates must be qualified to meet the CSSF's "fit-and-proper" criteria necessary for official designation as an authorized director or manager

  • Technical Core Competencies: Proven track record across treasury management, financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, audit management, capital and liquidity management, and finance operations within regulated financial services environments. Strong understanding of Group consolidation processes, financial governance frameworks, and interaction with auditors, regulators, and supervisory authorities

  • Language capabilities: Complete fluency in English

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

 

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact is met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

  • Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant, and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

 

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

 

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our Regulatory Legal team is the group responsible for maintaining and growing Kraken’s product offerings across the EU and UK and for advising the business on its day-to-day regulatory obligations. The Senior Counsel role is a remote role based in the UK or the EU, and will report into the EU/UK Regulatory Legal team. The role exists to own the significant volume of ongoing, business-as-usual regulatory work that currently falls to a small group of very senior lawyers – freeing them to focus on strategic licensing initiatives, complex transactions, and team leadership.

You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on:

  • Product advice covering Payward’s growing offerings in the EU and UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things)

  • Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under MiCA/EU or in the UK) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and

  • Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise.

We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector).

This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK or EU.

 

The opportunity

  • Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions

  • Support the team’s active licensing applications and other in-flight EU/UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel

  • Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting EU/UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations)

  • Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities

  • Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., MiCA and the UK Cryptoasset Regime, CBI and FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, DORA, outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business

  • Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the EU or UK (experience in one jurisdiction is sufficient; both is not required), including account-access and open banking obligations

  • Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations

  • Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., Digital Operational Resilience Act in the EU, or the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime in the UK)

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one

 
 

Nice to haves

title: Distinguished Engineer, Core DevOps
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer to lead technical direction across GitLab's Core DevOps services, the systems the majority of our users touch every day. Distinguished Engineers are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the most senior level of technical leadership within and across divisions at the company.</p> <p>Core DevOps builds continuous Integration, continuous deployment, planning, and source control experiences. These are among the most mature, highest traffic, and most deeply interconnected systems at GitLab. They carry years of accumulated architectural decisions, they sit in the critical path of our customers' own delivery pipelines, and they are being reshaped by the shift toward AI native development. The job is to raise their quality, converge them onto a coherent go-forward architecture, and retire accumulated risk, all without interrupting the millions of users and Fortune 100 organizations who depend on them.</p> <p>GitLab is pursuing a set of company-wide engineering goals: large gains in developer productivity, measurably higher quality in what we ship, and engineering practices reshaped around AI and agentic workflows. Core DevOps is where much of that strategy has to land, because these are the services our own engineers and our customers depend on daily. In this role you will bring that strategy into Core DevOps in a form that works for long lived production systems, and carry what you learn here back out to the rest of engineering.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set and continuously refine the go forward technical direction for CI, CD, Plan, and source code experiences, aligned against the horizontal architectural initiatives.</li> <li>Work directly with the VP of Engineering as her technical counterpart on planning, technical investment, and where the group's engineering effort should go.</li> <li>Translate GitLab's company-wide productivity, quality, and AI native engineering goals into concrete technical direction for Core DevOps, and turn into iterable roadmaps, partnering broadly across the org.</li> <li>Define what good means in measurable terms for these services, including availability, latency at p95 and p99, pipeline success rate, test reliability, data correctness, and defect escape rate, then hold designs and implementations to it.</li> <li>Maintain a clear and current picture of systemic technical risk across the group, including single points of failure, unowned critical paths, brittle coupling between CI/CD and Plan, scaling limits, and past decisions that now constrain the roadmap. Drive a prioritized plan to retire it.</li> <li>Lead the hardest design decisions hands on, writing code, prototypes, and proofs of concept where a design argument needs evidence behind it.</li> <li>Drive convergence on shared patterns, libraries, and paved paths, reducing how many different ways the same problem gets solved across the group.</li> <li>Design migration paths that let large, long lived systems change underneath users without breaking them, using incremental cutover, dual run, measurable rollback, and deprecation with clear timelines.</li> <li>Adopt the platform capabilities coming from GitLab's AI organization and the company's productivity initiatives into Core DevOps, feed this group's requirements back into them, and help prove what works on systems of this scale and maturity.</li> <li>Serve as the escalation point for complex or contested technical decisions across the group, including those where no single team owns the outcome.</li> <li>Review significant designs and merge requests in the group's critical paths, and use review to teach rather than only to gate.</li> <li>Ensure designs hold across GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, and respect multi-tenant, compliance, and data governance boundaries in each.</li> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and SRE so Core DevOps services are observable and debuggable, and so failure modes degrade gracefully instead of cascading.</li> <li>Make architectural constraints and opportunities clear to Product in roadmap terms, so that technical investment and product ambition get planned together instead of traded off late.</li> <li>Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let teams across the group make aligned decisions independently.</li> <li>Grow Principal and Staff Engineers across Core DevOps, raise the bar on design rigor and technical writing, and contribute to the technical hiring bar title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description: <p><strong>REQ ID:</strong> FEQ227R147</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based)</p> <p><strong>Recruiter:</strong> Dina Hussain</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our <strong>EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups </strong>business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.</p> <p>You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.</li> <li>Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.</li> <li>Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.</li> <li>Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.</li> <li>Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.</li> <li>Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.</li> <li>Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.</li> <li>Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.</li> <li>Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.</li> <li>Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.</li> <li>A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.</li> <li>Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.</li> <li>Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.</li> <li>Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.</li> <li>Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3078 - Strategy Director, Media Strategy - UK</strong></p> <p>We're seeking a strategic thinker with expertise in media effectiveness and storytelling to join our team at T&amp;P.
