As such, it is ideally suited for a strategist who is keen to develop a broader skillset than media alone, as well as gain experience managing senior client stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Whilst your average to do list will vary from day to day, typical responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading strategic responses, narratives for pitches as well as delivering genuine data-driven insight to client teams</li> <li>Delivering key internal strategic workstreams, planning and insight training as well as encouraging agency creativity and innovation</li> <li>Present work in agency forums, lead agency brainstorms as well as identify and develop award entries</li> <li>Staying up to date with trends and sharing this with strategy teams alongside contributing to thought pieces and external events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>We are most interested in your ability to articulate the client’s challenge succinctly and turn that into actionable instructions for media planning teams. The skillset and experience you may have had to get to this point may vary but in general will include:</li> <ul> <li>Both ATL and Digital media channel knowledge</li> <li>The gravitas to be a trusted strategic partner to key clients</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships across the agency</li> <li>Understanding of effectiveness best practice and a willing to improvise to deliver competitive advantage</li> <li>Most importantly, you will be curious, clear and creative in your thinking, writing and speaking.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3594 - Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>The planning team are the guardians of creating industry leading, unrivalled work at Wavemaker. We are central conduits to all specialists, striving to push boundaries and have a positive impact on consumers and brand.</p> <p>Wavemaker UK is looking for a Director, Planning to join our growing planning team, to drive forward our planning output and help to create amazing work for our clients.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Media Planning Craft: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Wavemaker planning output on your specific client to create unrivalled work.</li> <li>Be able to articulate the strategic approach into media behaviours and train and support the wider team.</li> <li>Need strategic thinking on how we utilise tools and specialism outside of planning on response i.e. sources of growth, measurement, learning agenda, data, etc</li> <li>Build presence outside of current teams and drive visibility of planning team within the wider agency.</li> <li>Bring a fresh perspective to planning approaches including the use of different tools, new insights and coach others to challenge the status quo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Effective communication:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Overall responsibility for the development of all planning responses, ensuring we are developing unrivalled work in all executions.</li> <li>Manage senior client relationships, understanding what they need for their business and how to drive growth for them.</li> <li>Manage the planning team ensuring the have clear personal objectives, structure and regular reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Idea creation and storytelling: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and develop relationship with media owners and look for opportunities to create unrivalled work</li> <li>Have an advanced commercial understanding of Wavemakers products and services. Understanding which are suitable for their clients and how sell in solutions.</li> <li>Be a story telling expert, driving added value with the team and quality boosting output.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Practice Area Knowledge – Advanced- </strong>Demonstrates advanced understanding of the industry as well as future trends Serves as an internal consultant/expert on at least some tools and technology.</p> <p>Effectively guides junior team members on advanced elements.</p> <p>Works with leadership team to develop new solutions and/or spot new applications</p> <p><strong>Problem Solving – Advanced -</strong> Performs complex analyses of a range of information and identifies issues before they become problems; helps others think about how to define or redefine complex problems. Supports business leaders to find solutions and evaluates others’ solutions to determine the best way forward. Understand how to resolve escalated issues and coaches others to problem solve. Manages escalations.</p> <p><strong>Stakeholder Management – Advanced - </strong>Capitalizes on deep understanding of (current or potential) client and agency organizational structures, business processes, strategic objectives and challenges in order to anticipate and meet their needs. Demonstrates expert knowledge and monitors the client’s industry and competitive environment in order to create effective solutions. Advises key stakeholders by continuously helping them to successfully navigate through critical business changes.​​​​​​​ Uses strong deep expertise and contextual awareness to explore complex issues with stakeholders and provide trusted advice, deliverables and campaign KPIs.</p> <p><strong>Effective Communication – Advanced - </strong>Leads the delivery of relevant and accurate information to drive maximum impact. Consistently delivers communications to influence and educate all levels of seniority, appropriately judging the demands of the situation. Creatively develops presentations and comms to help with the understanding/education of complex information. Guides others on the best practices and approaches for creating clear, concise and organized communication materials to convey plans in a user-friendly way.</p> <p><strong>Campaign Management – Expert -</strong> Sets the standard for accuracy and thoroughness so that sufficiently detailed information is logged correctly.&nbsp; Balances short-term considerations with long-term goals and ensures that critical deliverables are met.&nbsp; Manages multiple overlapping timelines and competing demands, weighing the needs of different stakeholders across the business to determine priorities for parallel projects and sets priorities according to business needs.</p> <p><strong>Compelling storytelling – Advanced -</strong> Lead and direct the creation of a story, taking into account client knowledge levels and needs. Applies deep expertise and sound judgement to persuade key decision makers on recommendation, considering all implications. raw.title: Senior Associate Regulatory Compliance
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The Regulatory & Compliance Division (RCD) at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal, compliance and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal, compliance and financial risks.

The EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team forms part of the second line of defence (2LOD) at Airwallex whilst operating within the larger RCD function. We are a proactive and trusted business partner committed to enabling Airwallex’s growth and strategic goals by providing an advisory and oversight role. Our team culture is collaborative, impact-driven with a focus on continuous improvement. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, empowerment, and high performance.

This role is a newly created role with a specific focus on our UK business. This role will be a key member of the EMEA Regulatory Compliance Team, based in our London office with a direct line to the Senior Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK.

What you’ll do

As Senior Associate / Manager, Regulatory Compliance, UK, you will deliver on the regulatory engagement strategy for Airwallex in the UK. You will maintain our licensing responsibilities and coordinate with all internal and external parties as necessary to ensure compliance through the communication of regulatory requirements, cross-functional collaboration to productize solutions and offerings, implementation and execution of processes, accurate execution and filing of regulatory reports, renewal of registrations and licenses, end-to-end management of regulatory examinations, and interfacing with UK regulators (including the FCA) on ad-hoc inquiries. You will analyse new and existing products and provide guidance to ensure that our 2LOD controls are fit for purpose and comply with regulatory obligations, guide the first line business to enable the maturity of both customer-facing and internal back-office processes and product features.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Airwallex Group’s expansion by managing the regulatory compliance components of licence authorisation processes

  • Act as a key stakeholder in relation to licence applications, business plan updates and information requests between Airwallex and our regulators

  • Ensure that our regulatory compliance and regulatory reporting obligations are maintained for all Airwallex Group entities in the UK

  • Support and / or manage on-site exams, inspections and audits (in collaboration with our RCD colleagues)

  • Advise the business with respect to regulatory change initiatives with a particular focus on how to effectively manage compliance risk attached to new and evolving UK laws and FCA rules

  • Develop policies, processes and provide advice in relation to regulatory risk obligations that exist within the 1st line business

  • Manage regulatory compliance risk within the Airwallex Risk Management Framework and associated escalation process (inc. governance forums and board reporting)

  • Advise the business in relation to conduct risk, Consumer Duty, complaints governance (including Financial Ombudsman Service escalations), and ethics matters relating to our financial services licences

  • Deliver the Compliance Monitoring Program through assisting with targeted and thematic reviews on a wide range of topics to ensure appropriate organisational maturity

  • Deliver the Airwallex Group’s Compliance Training for employees and conduct ad-hoc training to specific business areas as required

  • Conduct ‘Proactive Special Ops’ projects to unlock business or operational issues to enable Airwallex to achieve its strategic goals more rapidly

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with regulatory compliance experience in a financial institution, FinTech, legal / consulting firm, or combination of the above (minimum 4 years for Senior Associate; minimum 6 years for Manager)

  • Familiarity with financial regulatory laws, rules, regulations and industry best practices in the UK (specifically FCA-regulated environments)

  • Data proficiency - ability to work with data and leverage it for strategic decision-making

  • Ability to operate strategically and think creatively to solve complex regulatory compliance challenges

  • Superior communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to a wide range of stakeholders including regulators, executive leadership, and front-line staff

  • Experience with developing and/or maintaining a compliance program within a financial institution, preferably in respect of payments and e-money activity

  • Exposure to licensing processes, regulatory reporting, regulatory expansion, and RegTech or technology-driven compliance solutions

  • Understanding of financial products and related conduct risk, ethics, and controls

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience dealing with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and handling escalations to the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Staff Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt’s AdTech &amp; Promotions team is building the systems that power how restaurants and brands grow on our platform. From campaign creation to optimization and forecasting, we develop tools that help advertisers make smarter decisions and drive measurable results. As we expand our offering, we are investing in new capabilities that combine real-time data, scalable systems, and intuitive user experiences to unlock the next phase of growth.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Engineer</strong> to join the Wolt AdTech &amp; Promotions organization, who can drive technical direction across this space and help us build reliable, scalable systems that directly impact revenue and advertiser success.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <ul> <li>Drive the technical vision and architecture for Wolt’s AdTech and Promotions platforms, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and high-performing.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and projects, bringing architectural consistency to complex, large-scale systems.</li> <li>Work across the <strong>end-to-end domain</strong>, contributing to backend services, data pipelines, and advertiser-facing tools.</li> <li>Design and evolve systems that support <strong>campaign execution, targeting, ranking, allocation, and reporting</strong> in real-time or near real-time environments.</li> <li>Partner with engineering, product, and data stakeholders to align priorities, improve campaign performance, and manage trade-offs in a revenue-driven environment.</li> <li>Lead large cross-team projects, guiding them from concept to rollout across multiple regions and time zones.</li> <li>Ensure strong operational excellence, including observability, reliability, and incident readiness for revenue-critical systems.</li> <li>Promote best engineering practices, mentor engineers across teams, and support their growth in scalability and system design.</li> <li>Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical colleagues, ensuring clarity and alignment across functions.</li> <li>Contribute to the technical roadmaps of AdTech and Promotions platforms by collaborating with other senior engineers.</li> </ul> <p>This position is based in <strong>London</strong>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <h3><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven track record designing and scaling <strong>large distributed systems in production environments</strong>.</li> <li>Strong understanding of system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Experience working with <strong>data-intensive and real-time or near real-time systems</strong>.</li> <li>Familiarity with AdTech concepts such as <strong>targeting, ranking, attribution, or experimentation</strong> is a strong plus.</li> <li>Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and languages; while many of our services are written in Kotlin and Go, we are looking for someone language-agnostic.</li> <li>Ability to dive quickly into new domains and navigate complex system interactions.</li> <li>Familiarity with modern cloud-native tools and data systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Kafka, MongoDB).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Communication &amp; Influence</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong communicator with the ability to influence, align, and build consensus across diverse teams and stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a global environment across <strong>US and international teams</strong>.</li> <li>Skilled at translating complex technical decisions into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, helping raise the technical bar across teams.</li> <li><strong>Strong sense of ownership combined with a collaborative mindset</strong>, able to work effectively across team boundaries to deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Proactive in identifying opportunities and gaps across teams</strong>, and driving alignment to solve problems holistically rather than locally.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>At Wolt, this role provides a rare opportunity to work on <strong>challenging AdTech problems at scale</strong>, where technical decisions directly impact revenue and user experience.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a <strong>total compensation model</strong>, combining a competitive base salary with DoorDash RSUs.</p> <p>You will play a key role in <strong>building and evolving the next generation of advertisement tools and platforms</strong>, shaping how advertisers create, manage, and optimize campaigns across Wolt. This is not just about maintaining systems, but about <strong>defining and scaling new capabilities in a fast-growing domain</strong>.</p> <p>As a Staff Engineer, you will have <strong>end-to-end ownership and high autonomy</strong>, with the ability to influence architecture, product direction, and engineering practices across teams. Your work will have <strong>clear, measurable business impact</strong>, directly contributing to revenue growth and advertiser success.</p> <p>You’ll be part of a <strong>global company operating at scale</strong>, collaborating with teams across Europe and the US, and solving problems that span multiple markets, use cases, and customer segments.</p> <p>This role also offers strong opportunities for <strong>career growth and scope expansion</strong>, whether through deep technical leadership, cross-domain influence, or progression toward more senior individual contributor roles.</p> <p>Alongside the technical challenge, you’ll work with talented engineers and leaders in a <strong>diverse and international environment</strong>, shaping both our systems and engineering culture while mentoring and learning from others.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p data-path-to-node="0">We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid based in the UK role, reporting to the Senior Sales Engineering Manager in the Solutions Consulting department. You will be a key technical driver in our mission, presenting the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers and translating their goals into enticing, relevant recommendations. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through their transformational journey while delivering technical victories.</p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li>Present the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers</li> <li>Set the vision and translate goals into enticing and relevant recommendations</li> <li>Become the trusted advisor to our clients while aiding their transformational journey</li> <li>Gather customer technical requirements and promote the value proposition in POV, presentations, and demos</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="4"> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. title: Campaign Operations Manager
description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow. We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation. YOUR MISSION As Campaign Operations Manager, your mission will be to own the successful delivery and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns from initial planning through to post-campaign analysis. You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights. Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end delivery of digital advertising campaigns, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis. Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives. Monitor campaign performance and proactively optimise activity to improve delivery and results. Troubleshoot campaign issues, resolve blockers and minimise delivery and revenue risk. Produce high-quality campaign reports and post-campaign analysis decks that translate performance data into clear, actionable insights. Present campaign performance, findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external clients when required. Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners. Identify commercial opportunities, including campaign upweights, extensions and improvements that could deliver additional value for clients and Carwow. Continuously review Campaign Operations processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability. Support the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards. KEY REQUIREMENTS Experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad-tech environment. Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign setup, optimisation, delivery and reporting. Experience using an ad server or campaign management platform, ideally Google Ad Manager. Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations. A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving problems and improving campaign performance. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work. Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance clearly. A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how effective campaign management supports revenue and client retention. A collaborative, adaptable mindset and an interest in improving processes through technology, automation and AI. BONUS POINTS Experience working within the automotive, publishing or digital media industry. Knowledge of programmatic advertising, paid social, YouTube or off-site display campaigns. Experience with demand-generation or lead-generation campaigns. Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms. Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects. WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities. You’ll need to be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, taking ownership and proactively identifying potential issues before they affect delivery. You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes. INTERVIEW PROCESS Introductory call with our Talent team Online interview with the Hiring Manager In-person presentation interview Values Interview WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Competitive comp package 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more! Employee-friendly share options Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution Vitality private healthcare insurance Life Assurance - 4x annual salary Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme Generous learning and development budget £500/€550 home office budget Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW

The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow.

We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation.

YOUR MISSION

As Campaign Operations Manager, your mission will be to own the successful delivery and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns from initial planning through to post-campaign analysis.

You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of digital advertising campaigns, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis.

  • Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives.

  • Monitor campaign performance and proactively optimise activity to improve delivery and results.

  • Troubleshoot campaign issues, resolve blockers and minimise delivery and revenue risk.

  • Produce high-quality campaign reports and post-campaign analysis decks that translate performance data into clear, actionable insights.

  • Present campaign performance, findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external clients when required.

  • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners.

  • Identify commercial opportunities, including campaign upweights, extensions and improvements that could deliver additional value for clients and Carwow.

  • Continuously review Campaign Operations processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability.

  • Support the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad-tech environment.

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign setup, optimisation, delivery and reporting.

  • Experience using an ad server or campaign management platform, ideally Google Ad Manager.

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations.

  • A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving problems and improving campaign performance.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.

  • Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance clearly.

  • A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how effective campaign management supports revenue and client retention.

  • A collaborative, adaptable mindset and an interest in improving processes through technology, automation and AI.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience working within the automotive, publishing or digital media industry.

  • Knowledge of programmatic advertising, paid social, YouTube or off-site display campaigns.

  • Experience with demand-generation or lead-generation campaigns.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as DV360, Meta Ads Manager, Salesforce, Driftrock or audience-management platforms.

  • Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects.

WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities.

You’ll need to be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, taking ownership and proactively identifying potential issues before they affect delivery. You’ll also work closely with different teams to find solutions and should be motivated to challenge and improve existing ways of working not simply follow established processes.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Online interview with the Hiring Manager

  • In-person presentation interview

  • Values Interview

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive comp package

  • 28 days' holiday plus bank holidays, increasing to 35 with length of service, plus extras for house moves, weddings and more!

  • Employee-friendly share options

  • Pension scheme via Royal London - up to 5% company contribution

  • Vitality private healthcare insurance

  • Life Assurance - 4x annual salary

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, including up to 20 weeks' full pay maternity and shared parental leave, and 8 weeks' full partner pay, as well as fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • 'Work from abroad for a month' annual scheme

  • Generous learning and development budget

  • £500/€550 home office budget

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

You take ownership of complex technical systems end to end, from design through to production.</li> <li>Solid experience with low-code and no-code workflow platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Retool, Gumloop, or similar, to design and run cross-system automations.</li> <li>You know when automation is the right answer and when it is not. title: Senior Backend Engineer: Machine Learning Infrastructure
description: About Us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About The Role The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the shared backend services and platform capabilities that Constructor's ML and product teams rely on to develop, deploy, and run machine learning at scale - from model serving (including LLMs) to the specialized storages and data pipelines behind it. We are a service team by nature: our roadmap is shaped by the needs of product teams, and we succeed when they can move faster with less friction. We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is comfortable with, and motivated by this dynamic, and who will take end-to-end ownership of core services. In the near and mid-term, our focus areas include: Making ML workloads easy to run, scale, and operate for every team Providing self-service, configurable infrastructure components to ML and product teams Owning and evolving core ML services and related pipelines with a high bar for reliability and performance Challenges you will tackle Design, build, and operate high-load distributed backend services that power the company's ML infrastructure Take end-to-end ownership of core ML services and related data pipelines: from design and implementation to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement Partner with ML and product teams to understand their needs and turn them into reliable, reusable platform capabilities Make and defend technical decisions: evaluate trade-offs, design first, and own the outcome Be responsible for what you and your team do Requirements 5+ years of professional experience in backend or platform engineering Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language) Hands-on experience developing on a public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or with self-managed Kubernetes - AWS is our primary platform, but we're not limited to it Experience designing and building distributed, high-load services and APIs Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and their trade-offs Design-driven engineering mindset: we're a coding-assistant-friendly environment and expect you to use modern AI tools - but you lead with system design and a strong understanding of their applicability and trade-offs Ownership and proactivity: you can't close your eyes to problems, but are ready to solve them and take responsibility for outcomes You are friendly and willing to help your teammates & others Nice to have: Experience with Rust (or C/C++/Go) - a strong plus Experience developing or contributing to ML platforms or ML infrastructure - a strong plus Experience setting up and operating any vector database (Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate, OpenSearch, pgvector, etc.) - description: <p><strong>Associate Director, Supply Chain</strong></p> <p><strong>Company:</strong>&nbsp; Cycle Pharmaceuticals Ltd</p> <p><strong>Position Summary: </strong>This is a full-time position leading our Supply Chain department, working in our Cambridge office on a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days in the office).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You’ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.</p> <p>This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.</p> <p>This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company's growth.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Company&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that <strong>Every Single Patient Matters</strong>. This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we’re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.</p> <p>Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. Using cutting-edge drug delivery technologies, we enhance the efficiency of treatments, offering patients greater freedom and choice.</p> <p>If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:&nbsp;<a href="https://cyclepharma.com/patient-advocacy/patient-stories/">Patient Stories - Cycle Pharma</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing in this role:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Strategy, Planning and Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned to commercial priorities, product launches, lifecycle management and the organisation’s broader growth ambitions.</li> <li>Provide clear, evidence-based, risk-adjusted recommendations on supply priorities, inventory trade-offs, supplier performance and escalation requirements, enabling timely, transparent and commercially informed decision-making.</li> <li>Provide strategic oversight of the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing scheduling, distribution and product availability, ensuring a reliable and responsive supply network.</li> <li>Lead the Sales &amp; Operations Planning (S&amp;OP) process, bringing together commercial forecasts, customer demand, inventory strategy and manufacturing capacity to create a clear, aligned view of supply and demand. Proactively identify, communicate and mitigate emerging risks.</li> <li>Establish and optimise inventory policies and supply strategies that balance product availability, supply resilience, risk and working capital requirements.</li> <li>Define and maintain meaningful supply chain KPIs and performance measures, using data and insight to identify opportunities, strengthen accountability and drive continuous improvement across the supply network.</li> <li>Support business development initiatives, new product introductions and other growth initiatives, assessing supply chain requirements and developing scalable, compliant and fit-for-purpose supply solutions.</li> <li>Own the annual Supply Chain budget, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise costs and deliver value while maintaining regulatory compliance, supply resilience and product availability.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Governance and Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging providers, logistics partners, distributors, serialization providers and other critical supply chain partners, ensuring clear accountability and delivery against agreed service, quality and business requirements.</li> <li>Establish and maintain effective supplier governance, including structured performance reviews, service-level management, quality oversight, issue resolution and improvement plans, ensuring external partners consistently meet expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with Quality Assurance and relevant functions to ensure the external supply network operates in accordance with applicable GxP, GDP, DSCSA and other regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Lead the resolution and escalation of complex supply, quality, compliance and operational issues, coordinating internal teams and external partners to minimise business impact and protect product availability.</li> <li>Drive the development of scalable supply chain processes, improving visibility, data quality, operational efficiency and ways of working as the organisation and product portfolio grow.</li> <li>Provide governance and oversight of critical supply chain systems and data, including ERP, serialization, GS1 and inventory management platforms, ensuring robust master data, system integrity and reliable reporting.</li> <li>Establish a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the external supply network, using supplier performance insights, operational data and emerging risks to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>People Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop the Supply Chain function, setting clear priorities, expectations and ways of working while creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.</li> <li>Build team capability and succession strength through coaching, mentoring and targeted development, ensuring the function has the skills, expertise and capacity to support the organisation’s future growth.</li> <li>Develop strong, collaborative relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear supply chain insight and challenge to support informed business decisions and representing Supply Chain effectively across cross-functional leadership and governance forums.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed </strong><strong>in this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree (or equivalent experience) in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or Life Sciences.</li> <li>Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.</li> <li>Knowledge of GDP, DSCSA, serialisation, and global pharmaceutical supply chain regulations.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional projects, product launches, and business-critical supply chain initiatives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex external partnerships.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What can we offer to you:</strong></p> <p>In addition to being part of a great team and doing things that will make a real difference to patients’ lives, you will enjoy all the benefits that brings:</p> <ul> <li>A collaborative high performing work environment</li> <li>Performance based bonus</li> <li>Opportunity to join a fast growing and ambitious business</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>100% employer paid membership for Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Critical Illness Insurance</li> <li>Corporate Gym membership</li> <li>Regular team building events and an agile working environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Diversity and Inclusion statement:</strong></p> <p><em>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we are committed to creating an inclusive, respectful, positive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, age,&nbsp;</em><em>disability, or any other protected characteristic. We actively support and embrace diversity, and we are working to build a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.</em></p> <p><em>We value your unique contributions and encourage you to join us in shaping a more inclusive future. If you require any reasonable adjustments - whether during the application process or in the workplace - we will be happy to support your needs. At Cycle, equality, inclusion, and respect are at the core of everything we do. We fully comply with all applicable employment laws, including those related to non-discrimination, work authorization, and employment eligibility verification.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our London office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish: you can run selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>This role is based in London.</p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote from London. Once Pallet opens its London office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Coffee Chat with Sales Team - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our London office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent French: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in French</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.</p> <p><strong>Working model</strong></p> <p>This role is based in London.</p> <p>Working hours are generally <strong>9:00am-6:00pm London time</strong>, providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.</p> <p>You’ll typically spend:</p> <ul> <li>Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.</li> <li>Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.</li> <li>Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.</li> </ul> <p>Initially this role will be remote from London. Once Pallet opens its London office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Coffee Chat with Sales Team - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits&nbsp;</li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office&nbsp;</li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided&nbsp;</li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.</p> <p>Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip.&nbsp;</p> <p>Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.</p> <p>We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.</p> <p>RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&amp;A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.</p> <h2>Role Overview</h2> <p>As a Senior Growth Manager based in London, you will own a portfolio of strategically significant accounts across the UK and Western EMEA, driving revenue retention and growth for some of the most commercially important relationships in the region. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will operate with full autonomy from day one: leading your own growth plans, managing executive-level client relationships, and executing across the full account lifecycle without co-management.</p> <p>You will work closely with cross-functional teams across Growth, Analytics, and Operations to launch and optimize campaigns, surface performance insights, and translate data into decisions that move the business. You will report to the EMEA Growth lead and collaborate with a lean, senior team that moves fast and holds itself to a high standard.</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of RZR's EMEA strategy. The region manages a combined book of over $110K DRR across 30+ accounts, with a strong new business pipeline, and we need a senior operator who can own a meaningful portion of that portfolio independently and grow it.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Revenue Retention &amp; Growth</h3> <ul> <li>Drive net growth to meet or exceed revenue targets across your assigned portfolio</li> <li>Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities while actively managing churn risk and re-activation plays</li> <li>Drive product adoption and expansion to increase revenue quality and account depth</li> <li>Proactively surface client needs and gaps to inform both account strategy and commercial planning</li> </ul> <h3>Client Ownership &amp; Strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Lead account retention and growth plans with a multi-quarter forward view and clear, measurable milestones</li> <li>Build strong client relationships at all levels, from performance marketers to C-suite stakeholders</li> <li>Use QBRs and strategic sessions to drive progress, deepen engagement, and secure long-term commitment</li> <li>Communicate product capabilities and market changes in ways that are clear, compelling, and directly relevant to each client's business</li> <li>Provide market insights and best practices that position RZR as a strategic partner, not just a vendor</li> </ul> <h3>Campaign Management &amp; Performance Insights</h3> <ul> <li>Work with internal teams to launch, execute, and optimize campaigns aligned to client goals</li> <li>Monitor account health and identify performance issues before they become client concerns</li> <li>Deliver actionable insights tied to business impact, not just metrics</li> <li>Recommend creative and strategy adjustments to counter performance fatigue and sustain growth</li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional Collaboration</h3> <ul> <li>Lead cross-functional coordination to meet client expectations and execute growth plans on time</li> <li>Maintain clear escalation paths to resolve issues quickly and protect the client relationship</li> <li>Conduct client training sessions, platform walkthroughs, and onboarding as needed</li> </ul> <h3>Operational Excellence</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline documentation, and reporting with full personal accountability</li> <li>Ensure financial alignment including timely invoicing and budget tracking</li> <li>Report accurately and consistently to regional EMEA and global leadership</li> </ul> <h2>Required Skills and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>3 to 5 years of experience in mobile advertising, including at least 3 years in a client-facing growth or account management role</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of the programmatic advertising ecosystem</li> <li>Familiarity with the UK market; established relationships with key advertisers and agencies across the UK and Western EMEA are a significant advantage</li> <li>Proven ability to build high-touch client relationships, manage in-person engagements, and calibrate the right frequency and depth of contact</li> <li>Track record of independently managing and scaling commercial accounts, identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities without hand-holding</li> <li>Comfortable managing the full account lifecycle in a commercially dense, competitive market</li> <li>Willingness to travel regularly and engage clients and team members in person</li> <li>Ability to adapt quickly in a high-growth environment and lead growth initiatives with limited structural support</li> <li>Strong communication and presentation skills, able to engage confidently with clients from campaign managers to C-level executives</li> <li>Strong collaborator across diverse, globally distributed teams</li> <li>Familiarity with data analytics, machine learning, and advertising technology is a plus</li> <li>Fluent in English; an additional European language is an advantage</li> </ul> <h2>Why Join RZR in London?</h2> <ul> <li>Step into direct ownership of a commercially significant EMEA portfolio from day one: full autonomy, full accountability, and no co-management required</li> <li>Work with a privacy-centric, AI-driven programmatic platform as the UK market deepens and the product portfolio (User Acquisition, Retargeting, CTV) actively expands</li> <li>Earn a competitive base salary plus a structured commission plan where your performance directly determines your earnings ceiling</li> <li>Gain exposure to global advertisers, senior cross-functional teams, and major industry events across EMEA and beyond, with regular in-person client engagement built into the role</li> <li>Join a small, senior team where your contributions are visible, your voice carries weight, and direct access to leadership accelerates your development</li> </ul> <h2>Our Values</h2> <p>RZR operates by eight core behaviours: Extreme Ownership · Move Fast · Drive for Excellence · Proactive Communication · Courage · Curiosity · Deliver Results · Manage Ambiguity</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Modern software is complex and dependency-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster.&nbsp;</p> <p>Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40-year old C++ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures.</p> <p>Sound interesting?
