You won't inherit a full pipeline—you'll build it. The AEs who thrive here create demand and run a repeatable enterprise motion with intent.</p> <p><strong>Full-Cycle Ownership &amp; Pipeline Generation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals end to end, orchestrating SAs, CS, SDRs, and Marketing to win.</li> <li>Self-source a meaningful share of your pipeline through strategic, trigger-based prospecting—you create demand, you don't wait for it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Value-Based Selling &amp; MEDDPICC</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run rigorous discovery and qualify with discipline using MEDDPICC.</li> <li>Apply a structured enterprise motion (e.g., Command of the Message) to move deals with purpose and predictability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Storytelling &amp; Champion Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Translate technical depth into clear business outcomes and build a credible business case tied to measurable value.</li> <li>Map the buying committee, build internal champions, and earn trusted-advisor status—you sell insight, not a feature checklist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Forecast Discipline &amp; Ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage pipeline rigorously, forecast with precision, and consistently exceed targets.</li> <li>Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment—taking ownership over titles to win for the customer and the team.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Bring to the Table</strong></span></h2> <p>You’re a strategic, technical seller who loves simplifying complexity and guiding customers through transformation. You know how to navigate ambiguity, collaborate deeply, and earn trust through insight and credibility.</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of full-cycle enterprise sales experience in cybersecurity, DevOps, or developer tools.</li> <li>A strong track record of closing multi-threaded, six-figure deals with enterprise accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in a structured, playbook-driven motion—Command of the Message, Force Management, MEDDPICC (or MEDDIC), or a comparable value-selling methodology.</li> <li>Demonstrated over-attainment: President's Club, top-decile ranking, or a consistent record of beating quota.</li> <li>You've done your best work at high-growth companies where you had to <em>create</em> demand, not fulfill inbound—and you know the difference.</li> <li>Comfort selling to technical buyers—CISOs, Heads of Security, Engineering and Developer Productivity leaders.</li> <li>High curiosity and initiative—you don't follow scripts, you lead the conversation.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;">The Bar We Hire To</span></h2> <p>We hold a bar above the market, and we're transparent about what it is. The best reps at Endor aren't defined by pedigree—they're defined by how they operate. We hire people who:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with character.</strong> Commitment, humility, and grit. You've overcome something hard, you want to be the best, and you carry a strong moral compass into every room.</li> <li><strong>Are coachable by default.</strong> You seek feedback, act on it fast, and treat every deal as a chance to get better.</li> <li><strong>Think sharply and translate complexity.</strong> You build a credible business case and make hard concepts simple.</li> <li><strong>Have proven it where it's hard.</strong> You've carried a number at a high-growth, not-yet-household-name company and consistently beaten it.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Why Endor Labs</strong></span></h2> <p>We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our dev-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right.</p> <p>At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.</strong> We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.</p> <p>Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH.&nbsp;</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "<strong>Builder</strong>" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>&nbsp;🎯 VOTRE MISSION</p> <p>Nous recherchons un(e) <strong>AI Engineer confirmé(e)</strong> pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.</p> <p>Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au <strong>sein d'un collectif dédié</strong>, en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.</p> <p>Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&amp;A) à un <strong>véritable système agentique transactionnel</strong> capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University).</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li>Développement Agentique &amp; Fonctionnalités</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).</li> <li>Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH.</li> <li>Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.</li> </ul> <ol> <li>Qualité, Évaluation &amp; Observabilité (LLMOps)</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).</li> <li>Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.</li> <li>Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).</li> <li>Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.</li> <li>Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.</li> </ul> <ol> <li>Sécurité, Cloisonnement &amp; Déploiement International</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Management (ACLs) : Implémenter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d'accès au niveau de l'indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu'un collaborateur n'accède strictement qu'aux documents RH de son périmètre.</li> <li>Isolation &amp; Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.</li> <li>Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues.</li> </ul> <ol> <li>Produit &amp; Impact Business</li> </ol> <ul> <li>Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de DaiLY.</li> <li>Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès.</li> </ul> <p>🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE</p> <p>Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience :</strong> Profil confirmé justifiant de plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orienté IA. Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.</li> <li><strong>Stack Technique</strong> : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).</li> <li><strong>Expertise LLM &amp; Agentique </strong>: Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.</li> <li><strong>Qualité &amp; Évaluation</strong> : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de <em>retrieval</em> ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / BigQuery / MLflow).</li> <li><strong>Langues </strong>: Anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).</li> </ul> <p>Les plus :&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.</li> <li>Expérience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des écosystèmes SIRH (ex: Workday).</li> <li>Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.</li> <li>Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d'APIs.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>🎁 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS</p> <ul> <li>L'opportunité de développer un produit d'IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.</li> <li>Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud / Vertex AI / Databricks).</li> <li>Une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux à Paris - Canal de l’Ourcq).</li> <li>Une culture du <em>delivery</em> axée sur l'autonomie, l'intelligence collective et la montée en compétences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).</li> <li>Des avantages attractifs (primes mensuelles/trimestrielles, actionnariat salarié).</li> <li>Une ambiance résolument tournée vers le sport (nombreuses corpos, tests produits, pauses déjeuner sportives ou non, …)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>DECATHLON DIGITAL&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.</p> <p><strong>Changeons la donne pour de bon.</strong> Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region. Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

Aircall is seeking a Regional Marketing Intern to support the execution of the DACH marketing strategy. In this role, you will help bring global priorities to life at a local level; ensuring our campaigns, events, partner initiatives, and GTM programs are tailored, relevant, and impactful for the  DACH market.

You will work closely with the Regional Marketing Manager (RMM), becoming an integral part of our local GTM engine, helping transform global campaigns into high-impact local experiences, and ensuring operational excellence across initiatives.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone eager to gain hands-on experience in regional marketing operations, campaign execution, localisation, event support, and GTM collaboration within a fast-growing SaaS environment.


Responsibilities:

  • Support execution of the DACH  regional marketing plan, helping deliver planned campaigns, events, webinars, partner initiatives, and local activations that ladder up to global priorities.

  • Review localised and adapted global campaigns, messaging, and assets, ensuring relevance and accuracy for the DACH market.

  • Assist with campaign and event operations, including asset QA and cross-functional coordination and resource requests with central marketing & campaign operation teams

  • Help ensure wider marketing and GTM teams have clear visibility into DACH marketing initiatives, by supporting the upkeep of marketing calendars, project plans, reporting rhythms, and tracking processes.

  • Support reporting and performance analysis, helping track leads and pipeline influence from regionally executed initiatives

  • Contribute market insights and competitor observations to inform DACH strategy and support ongoing GTM alignment.

  • Partner with local GTM teams on the operational execution of DACH marketing initiatives, ensuring consistent communication and visibility across teams.


    • Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor or Master degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field

  • First hand experience in Marketing / Events is a plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German (Dutch is a plus)

  • Proactive team player with positive attitude

  • Ability to handle multiple projects

    • This position is based in our Paris office.

    Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. About the Role:   As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.   By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.   This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. Key Responsibilities: Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth. Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans. Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities. Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty. Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting. Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes. Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies. Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives. Qualifications: Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets. Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy. Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value. Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis. Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively. Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene. Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership. Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform. Why Join our Account Management Team:   At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions.   This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership. title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
description: The AI-powered OS  for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.   Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.   The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. Role overview   Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.   Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.   This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.   To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. Commercial Growth Engagement  - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform. Sales Cycle -  Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution. Market Trends -  Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions. Relationship Building Partnering  - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption. Advisor -  Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications. Business Partnering -  Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits. Relationships -  Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey. About Fresha

title: Senior Product Designer
description: Updated in September 2026 About Upflow Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team. Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath. We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI. To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io . For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow . Your role at Upflow As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives. Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude) Plan and run user research and usability tests Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent Who you are 5+ years of experience in Product Design Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact You adhere to our operating principles Why join us Here what you’ll find at Upflow: International Mindset : We have offices in Paris and New York. Exciting moment : Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up. All-star team : Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise. Learning opportunity : Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills. Trusting environment : Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy. Best in class perks : 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity . Offsites : Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem Recruitment process 1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow. 2 - Home assignment Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to. 3 - Home assignment review Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us! 4 - Meet the team You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃 5 - Founder interview Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too. 6 - Reference check 7 - Alignment & offer If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job. ***** Diversity & Inclusion At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. raw.description:
Updated in September 2026

About Upflow

 

Upflow is the Financial Relationship Management (FRM) platform that helps B2B finance teams collect smarter and get paid by their customers faster, with AI agents working alongside the team.

Today, the order-to-cash process is mission critical for businesses, yet it remains fragmented across tools, teams, and workflows. Upflow brings this entire process into one system — four products covering the cycle from invoice to cash (Insights, Collections, Payments, and Cash Application), with AI agents that work alongside the team and a shared intelligence layer underneath.

We serve 500+ companies across 30+ countries, including Vercel, Lattice, and Productboard, and are backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Hedosophia, Hexa, and Lorimer. With teams across the US and Europe, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of finance, payments, and AI.

To learn more about what we do, visit upflow.io. For a behind-the-scenes look at how we work as a team, head to the Inside Upflow section of our blog at upflow.io/blog/inside-upflow.

Your role at Upflow

 

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll define solutions that allow finance teams to experience consumer grade UX in their day to day lives.

  • Lead end-to-end design projects, work closely with engineers, product managers and other stakeholders to ensure a high-quality implementation

  • Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals (we use Figma, Cursor and Claude)

  • Plan and run user research and usability tests

  • Own our design system to ensure efficient delivery of new features

  • Contribute to overall strategy and decision-making about product direction

  • Collaborate with Marketing on our brand design, ensuring our app and communications feel coherent

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Design

  • Curiosity for people’s problems, and a drive to figure out best-in-class solutions for them

  • Track record of shipping high‑impact product work in B2B or complex workflows

  • You have embraced AI capabilities to craft your designs

  • A portfolio that clearly explains context, constraints, your decisions, and impact

  • You adhere to our operating principles

Why join us

Here what you’ll find at Upflow:

  • International Mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to join early and contribute to the Design function from the ground up.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development in hard and soft skills.

  • Trusting environment: Hands-off management style. We have a strong culture of ownership and autonomy.

  • Best in class perks: 35 paid days off, meal vouchers, cool offices, top-of-the-range equipment, great healthcare, and competitive salary and equity.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem

Recruitment process

1 - Screening call with JM, Product Director

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

 

2 - Home assignment

Your time to shine! You’ll be given a home assignment. Yes, it is designed to assess your skills. But it’s also designed to give you a better taste of what being part of Upflow is like. Again, hiring is a two-way street! Ultimately: we believe assignments are a great way to control our biases. We care for what you do; not your schooling, social background, or the gender you identify yourself to.

 

3 - Home assignment review

Your hiring manager will spend up to 60 minutes debriefing your case with you. A peer can take part in this review. Hiring managers at Upflow are looking for team players: taking and giving feedback is key to thriving with us!

 

4 - Meet the team

You'll meet with members of the team so you can foresee yourself as part of it 😃

 

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Reference check

 

7 - Alignment & offer

If you’ve made it this far, chances are we like each other and it feels like Upflow is a place you can grow and shine over the next few years. We will align on the right way for you to come on board, and if successful in that process we will extend you an offer, and you can relax and get ready for your new job.

 

*****

 

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. title: Legal Counsel – Commercial Contracts
description: ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content . Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds. Founded in 2021 , we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris , growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo. If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media , and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure . Location : Hybrid from Paris or full remote Role Overview ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou , our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts. What you will do 1. Contracts You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries. Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding. You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered. You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth. 2. Tools, processes and enablement We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part. Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations. 3. Privacy and security You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you. What we are looking for You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did. You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation. You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty. You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions. You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work. You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts. What’s fun about this role You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent. As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic. You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work. raw.title: Legal Counsel – Commercial Contracts
raw.description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world's biggest sports organizations. We work with 300+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including Ligue 1 and Premier League clubs, NBA and NFL teams, the Tour de France, the Australian Open, and leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, edit and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 50-person team based between New York and Paris, growing 2x year over year with 98% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you’re passionate about sports and thrive in fast-paced environments - and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

 

Location: Hybrid from Paris or full remote

Role Overview

ScorePlay signs deals with some of the biggest organizations in sports, and every one of them starts with a contract. We are hiring a Commercial Contracts Counsel to own that: redlines, negotiations, signatures, the whole thing. You work directly with Lou, our General Counsel, and are the first point of contact for Sales on contracts.

What you will do

1. Contracts

  • You review, redline and negotiate the agreements that close our deals: MSAs, service agreements, order forms, SOWs, NDAs and DPAs, with clubs, leagues, federations, broadcasters and brands, often across several countries.

  • Sales comes to you when a deal is stuck on terms, and your job is to unstick it: fast turnaround, pragmatic fallbacks, and the judgement to know when a point is worth holding.

  • You partner with Sales, Finance, RevOps and Customer Success so contract terms match how the deal is actually priced, booked and delivered.

  • You take a share of vendor and partner agreements alongside Lou, split based on what is moving and where you want to build depth.

2. Tools, processes and enablement

  • We use AI heavily in contract work: drafting, first-pass reviews, summarizing counterparty terms. We want someone who genuinely enjoys this and keeps looking for a smarter way to handle the repetitive part.

  • Our legal playbook is young. You execute it, then you help Lou refine it with what you see in real negotiations.

3. Privacy and security

  • You contribute to customer security, privacy and vendor due-diligence questionnaires, and to DPA and international transfer questions. The heart of the role is contracts, with room to grow into broader compliance work if that interests you.

What we are looking for

  • You know commercial contracts inside out. 3 to 5 years of experience, most of it in-house, with contracts at the core of what you did.

  • You work autonomously. Give you an MSA or a set of customer redlines and you come back with a position, a fallback and a recommendation.

  • You ship fast. A solid answer today beats a perfect one on Friday, and you're comfortable making the call at 80% certainty.

  • You're resourceful. When something is unclear, you dig, you ask, you find a way, rather than waiting for perfect instructions.

  • You like helping people win. Supporting a Sales team means being responsive, available, and genuinely happy when a deal signs because of your work.

  • You're excited by AI. You already use it in your legal work, or you can't wait to, and you keep looking for smarter ways to handle the repetitive parts.

What’s fun about this role

  • You negotiate international contracts with some of the biggest names in sports: clubs, leagues, federations and broadcasters on every continent.

  • As our first commercial counsel, you own your function and you're the main partner of the Sales team on both sides of the Atlantic.

  • You sit in sales calls with senior stakeholders at major sports organizations, on deals worth USD 50k to 500k a year. When a deal closes, you're usually one of the key players who made it work.

  • Small team, short loops. You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, build playbooks, experiment with AI and new tools, and learn a ton along the way.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will develop and implement robust algorithms to facilitate complex robotic operations in real-world manufacturing environments. Our team is responsible for both motion planning and grasping, with this role dedicated specifically to advancing our grasping capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong foundation in robotics—whether from a background in motion planning, control systems, or manipulation—to write excellent, production-quality code. You will help abstract the inherent complexity of robotic tasks into intuitive, seamless workflows, enabling users to transition from design to execution without needing deep subject matter expertise. Working alongside a diverse team of roboticists and application engineers, you will integrate and validate solutions across various industrial tasks and contribute to the launch of impactful robotics products.</p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Algorithm Development:</strong> Design, implement, and maintain efficient, production-ready algorithms for robotic grasping.</li> <li><strong>Problem Solving:</strong> Collaborate with the team to apply cutting-edge advancements in robotics to practical, real-world industrial problems.</li> <li><strong>Technical Execution:</strong> Transform complex partner requirements into highly reliable, functional, and scalable technical outcomes.</li> <li><strong>System Reliability:</strong> Improve our core robotics software framework, ensuring high code quality and contributing to a highly reliable product.</li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience in robotics (backgrounds in motion planning, control, or grasping/manipulation are all welcome).</li> <li><strong>Software Engineering:</strong> Exceptional programming skills in C++ and Python, with a proven track record of writing clean, efficient, and production-quality software.</li> <li><strong>Robotics Fundamentals:</strong> Strong foundation in linear algebra, spatial transformations, kinematics, and rigid body dynamics.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Experience:</strong> Direct experience testing, deploying, and iterating on physical robot hardware.</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>PhD in Robotics or a related field with a specific focus on motion planning, controls, or grasping.</li> <li>Prior exposure to or interest in robotic grasping and manipulation projects.</li> <li><strong>Full-Stack Robotics:</strong> Experience developing across the entire robotics stack, ranging from writing kinematics and motion generation to system integration and testing.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Intrinsic, we are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment at Intrinsic is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. Intrinsic does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. It is Intrinsic’s policy to comply with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.</p> <p>If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at: ----- Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.&nbsp;Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API,&nbsp;payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50&nbsp;million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent&nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or&nbsp;someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&nbsp;correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that&nbsp;freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&nbsp;product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&nbsp;finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&nbsp;team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk&nbsp;through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Switzerland Based </strong>Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.</p><p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running. AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity. Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability. Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts. Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench. Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping. raw.title: AI Engineer
raw.description:
Join our Data & Analytics team at Crypto Finance, headquartered in the Prime Tower in Zurich. Your primary mandate is pushing the company’s AI strategy forward: identifying use cases across departments, engineering production-grade AI and automation solutions, and helping to build the firm's AI governance practice. You will also contribute to the data platform that underpins Finance, Operations, and Risk reporting, since AI work at our company sits directly on top of that platform. 

This is a hybrid role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and an IDE. The work potentially spans AI agents and copilots, deterministic automation, RAG systems, and the data infrastructure they rely on. You will be expected to push back on bad use cases as much as you ship good ones. 

What you will do: 

AI & Automation Engineering 

  • Work with stakeholders across Compliance, Trading, Operations, Legal, Sales, and Finance to identify, scope, and prioritize use cases that genuinely move the needle. 
  • Engineer production data solutions: Deterministic automations, AI agents, RAG systems over internal documents, structured extraction pipelines. 
  • Build the firm's "innovation lab" environment where new use cases can be prototyped and evaluated. 
  • Maintain prompt and skill libraries as reusable, version-controlled assets, not as one-off scripts. 

AI Governance and Inventory 

  • Maintain the firm-wide inventory of AI systems and use cases, including those built outside D&A. 
  • Run the operational side of the company’s AI approval process: documentation, risk classification, model cards, evaluation artifacts. Policy is set at the executive level; you make sure the operational practice meets it. 
  • Conduct technical review of new AI initiatives proposed elsewhere in the company; advise on scope, risk, and design choices. 

Data Engineering and Platform 

  • Contribute to ELT pipelines on the Dagster + SQLMesh + dlt stack, primarily where AI & automation use cases require new data sources or transformations. 
  • Build the data substrate that AI workloads consume; feature views, document indexes, and structured event tables.  
  • Maintain infrastructure as code in Git with proper review and deployment standards. 

 

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of relevant experience. We are flexible on title, could be AI engineer, analytics engineer with AI focus, or data engineer who is pivoted to AI. What matters is shipped work. 
  • Demonstrable production experience with LLM applications: at minimum structured extraction with LLMs, and agentic patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows). You can describe what failed and what you learned. 
  • Strong Python; comfortable building production ready code, not just notebooks. 
  • Working knowledge of evaluation discipline for LLM applications (eval sets, regression tests, observability), conceptual understanding of retrieval, and how to handle hallucination. 
  • Familiarity with at least one orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and one transformation framework (SQLMesh, dbt). 
  • Solid SQL (window functions, joins, query design). 
  • Cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery. 
  • Genuine curiosity about regulated environments and the discipline they require. 
  • Professional proficiency in English (German is a plus). 
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss permit or EU/EFTA citizenship). 

Equally important is how you think: 

  • You reach for the simplest thing that works. Boring SQL before vector search. Rules before agents. You can explain why. 
  • You are comfortable saying "this is not an AI problem" when the right answer is a dashboard, a process fix, or a deterministic script. 
  • You can run a stakeholder workshop and write production code in the same week. 
  • You take documentation, evaluation, and audit trails seriously, not as overhead. 

Nice to have: 

  • Prior exposure to regulated financial services, crypto, or comparable model-risk environments. 

What we are not looking for: 

  • "Prompt engineers" with no production experience. 
  • Pure data engineers using this posting to pivot into AI without prior LLM work. 
  • Strategists or generalist "AI enthusiasts." This is a builder role. 

Benefits

  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

Please note:

  • We do not accept CVs from recruiting or staffing agencies.
  • Due to the Swiss/German labor legislation, we can only accept applicants who have the right to work in Switzerland or Germany (are in possession of a Swiss/German work permit or are EU/EFTA citizens). All other applications will not be considered.
  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss/German work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.

About cogify group

cogify was founded in Switzerland in 2018 and today combines expertise in consulting, AI, software engineering, cybersecurity and digital products.

We are expanding our cybersecurity capabilities and are looking for a Cybersecurity Architect with a strong focus on Zero Trust who understands complex IT environments and can translate security requirements into practical, implementable solutions.

Your Mission

As a Cybersecurity Architect, you work at the interface between business, security, technology and delivery.

You understand the challenges our customers face, assess existing environments and identify where security needs to evolve.

You combine consulting skills with strong technical expertise – from the first assessment and target architecture through technology selection and implementation together with our engineering teams.

You ask the right questions, challenge existing assumptions and communicate confidently with stakeholders from management to engineering teams.

Requirements

  • Assess existing IT and security environments and identify risks, gaps and improvement opportunities
  • Design Zero Trust and enterprise security target architectures
  • Develop practical security roadmaps and implementation concepts
  • Advise customers on security architecture, Zero Trust strategy and technology selection
  • Design solutions across IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network segmentation, cloud and endpoint security
  • Evaluate security technologies, products and licensing models against customer requirements
  • Translate business, security and compliance requirements into technically implementable solutions
  • Lead security workshops and architecture discussions with customers
  • Support implementation together with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps and software engineers
  • Help shape and further develop cogify’s cybersecurity offering

Your Profile

  • Experience in cybersecurity architecture, security engineering, cybersecurity consulting or a comparable role
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architectures, technologies and principles
  • Good knowledge of frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model or comparable approaches
  • Strong knowledge of areas such as IAM, ZTNA, SASE, network security, segmentation, cloud security and access control
  • Experience designing or implementing enterprise security solutions
  • Ability to evaluate security technologies and select appropriate solutions for specific requirements
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networks, identity, authentication and cloud environments
  • Ability to translate complex security topics into clear decisions and practical solutions
  • Confident communication with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Independent, pragmatic and quality-focused way of working
  • Fluent English or German is required

Nice to Have

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, ISSAP or comparable qualifications
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike or similar technologies
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments
  • German, French or other languages in addition to your primary working language

We offer a competitive salary, a flexible working environment, modern technologies and the opportunity to take real ownership of your work.

We are looking for people who ask good questions, understand complex systems and want to build security solutions that work in practice.
